description: Summary of Recorded Ground Motions from the 2024 Muswellbrook, NSW, Earthquake Sequence is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. On 23 August 2024, the communities of Muswellbrook and Denman in New South Wales experienced a moment magnitude M 4. 7 earthquake, with its epicentre near the Mount Arthur Coal Mine in the Upper Hunter region. This earthquake was followed by numerous aftershocks, including a M 4. 4 event on 24 August, a M 4. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are Muswellbrook earthquake swarm, Published_External, Seismology and Seismic Exploration, earthquake damage, earthquake swarm. It offers 2 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2025-11-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
